dataset.description:
Description of this data set informs on how social survey (written structured) questionnaire will be used in the research to collect data from diverse audiences to assess their attitudes and behaviors , and satisfaction of needs (FHN) related to circular economy governance. 
Two sources of data will fall under this category of data set according to form how data are obtained:
1)  electronical documents (word or pdf) of filled in questionnaires, 
2) Internet Survey (Survey Monkey Software Platform or other), data will be processed using AI.

distribution.title:
Social survey (written structured) questionnaire will collect data from diverse audiences to assess their attitudes and behaviors , and satisfaction of needs (FHN) related to circular economy governance. Two sources of data will fall under this category of data set according to form how data are obtained. Data will be gathered using structured questionnaire ( updates of questionnaire forms and bilingual versions will be developed to better design for research purposes and meet respondents cultural differences) form in two ways
 1) electronical documents (word or pdf) of filled in questionnaires, the respondent wont be personalized (anonymous), these data will be summarized and processed in Excel form. This approach will be used at the Test phase of the survey, analysing limited number of responses of selected audience ( up to 50)
 2) by submitted answers in an Internet Survey (Survey Monkey Software Platform or other), data will be processed using AI. Estimated number of responses is 200-300.
Survey questionnaires will be granted open access after completion of the project.
Aggregated data will be granted open access 2 years after completion of the project due to intentions to use them for scientific purposes.

This data set will summarize data and other information related to implemented social survey methods based on group discussions. 
Group discussions will be implemented in different research contexts, at different stages of the research and involving different stakeholder groups. Each group will be specified as an event with it title, goals, list of participants, summary of discussed key topics. Audio recording and  Transcript of group work will be used in specific situations.

1) to receive feedback on interim findings from the multi-diciplinary experts and decision-makers
2) to present initial findings to the local stakeholders and discuss in depth factors affecting (supporting or hindering) circular economy practices from the human centered perspective view point
3) to validate results and jointly generate solutions and recommendations for better practices

dmp.description:
This Data Management Plan (DMP) provides a detailed framework for data collection, storage, analysis, and sharing. It ensures that the data collected in the study of social sustainability in circular economy practices is handled securely, ethically, and in accordance with the project’s tasks and aims.
This project aims to study the social sustainability of circular economy (CE) governance at the local (municipal) level in the context of Latvia. Social sustainability aspect will be addressed from the perspective of Fundamental Human Needs (FHN) theory emphasizing human centred perspective in CE governance. Humanity dimension will be studied through micro-level approach, identifying individual perspectives in respect to CE practices, and hindering and supporting factors thereof.
FHN will be structured and analysed related to the CE governance instruments. The concept of access to resources ( including information, skills, infrastructure, ad decision-making etc.) will be unutilized to study CE practices in concrete municipal contexts- case studies. In-depth case studies (CSR) in three municipalities will allow identification and description of CE governance at the local level. These pilot municipalities will be carefully selected based on sufficient diversity, content depth, and the municipality's interest in engaging with the project. The overall design of this research is based on a holistic approach embedded in the System Approach Framework (SAF). The system represents interactions between its economic- social-ecological and governance components and involved stakeholders. The CE governance subsystem will be studied :1) multi-level ( macro, meso and micro) and 2) multi-stakeholder perspective. CE governance will be studied addressing five priority material flows as defined in the EU Circular economy action plan: 1) transport/mobility, 2) food, 3)plastic, 4) building, and 5) textiles.
The data collection will be based on: 1) profound scientific and grey literature studies; 2) 3) qualitative data (interviews, group discussions); 3) quantitative data (original survey questionnaire) and 4) multicriteria analysis (MCA) methods.
The outputs of the research will be policy recommendations for CE governance.
